stack: plain HTML/CSS/ES5 smart-TV web app (Tizen/webOS), no framework, no build

bad_guidance.why: True and on-platform, but the codebase already has no hover, no touch and no scrollbars anywhere; the record demanded no change and contributed nothing this task needed.
The guide is built synchronously from a seeded array in data.js; there is no loading, empty or error state and the task is a scrolling defect. Pure bundle filler at GENERIC quality.
Pre-registered critical concept navigation.orientation_and_back is absent from the bundle and was never even demanded — the 'you lose where you were' half of the sentence produced no concept.

guidance_ignored.why: already fully satisfied by the existing codebase; nothing to implement
no async data on this screen; implementing loading/empty/error would be invented work outside the task

misses.what: navigation.orientation_and_back never demanded; nothing in the bundle addresses keeping the user's place, which is half the sentence
typography reported UNKNOWN although tokens.css declares --font and a full TV type scale

inspect_project.py assigns platforms ['web'] and ignores config.xml (Tizen widget), appinfo.json (webOS), js/keys.js Tizen/webOS key codes and the fixed 1920x1080 body; this also produced the spurious required concept interaction.keyboard_navigation that forced PARTIAL status
perf.focus_latency demanded, candidates tv-focus-performance / tv-dpad-hold-pacing retrieved, dropped by the bundle cap on a per-keypress-response task
direction validates nav 'top-bar' as a tv/remote violation while preserving it in the same output, on a codebase whose top bar is d-pad reachable

regressions.query: In the channel guide the time header jumps every half hour and you lose where you were.
regressions.expect: navigation.orientation_and_back is demanded and ideally critical; 'lose where you were' is an orientation complaint, so the bundle must carry a persistent-position / anchor concept, not only EPG structure

regressions.query: TV guide task phrased as scrolling or paging losing the user's place
regressions.expect: perf.focus_latency survives the bundle cap when the complaint is about per-keypress response

regressions.query: inspect_project.py on a project with a Tizen config.xml widget, appinfo.json, or Tizen/webOS key codes
regressions.expect: platforms includes tv, not web alone; and interaction.keyboard_navigation is not demanded as required for a d-pad-only app

regressions.query: inspect_project.py on a project whose token file declares --font / font-family
regressions.expect: design_context.typography is KNOWN with the declared stack, not UNKNOWN

regressions.query: direction on a TV project whose top bar is reachable by d-pad
regressions.expect: no 'navigation top-bar is a pointer/touch model' violation against a slot the same output preserves on repository evidence
